Source Code Snippet: PluginInterfaceRef& operator=(PluginInterfaceRef&& other) { if (this != &other) { _interface = other._interface; other._interface = nullptr; } return *this; }
Issue Description: Move assignment overwrites an existing interface pointer without releasing it and does not transfer _service which can cause leaks and inconsistent ownership state.
Suggested Fix: Release current resource before assignment and move both _interface and _service while nulling the source object.

Issue Description: t2_event_s is called with error before checking allocation success so allocation failure can propagate a null pointer to API usage.
Suggested Fix: Check strdup result before use and emit a fallback log/return path when allocation fails.
